summary: AstroHealth Edge OS is an offline-capable autonomous crew health monitoring and clinical triage workstation built for deep-space Artemis and Mars missions where communication delays with Earth exceed 14 minutes. Powered by a local Python 3 telemetry engine and SQLite Electronic Health Record, it integrates real space radiation fluxes (ICARTT P01/ARML3dr), astronaut genomics (NASA GeneLab OSD-195), and clinical ICU blood gas and metabolic streams (MIMIC-III) alongside crew self-exams, camera inspection, and daily diet, exercise, and mental health logs. Telemetry is denoised using Exponential Moving Averages, evaluated with 5-sample Ordinary Least Squares solar particle storm prediction, scored with a spaceflight-adapted NEWS2 clinical acuity matrix, and displayed on an interactive zero-circle flight-deck Digital Twin schematic. Every alert delivers plain-language physiological explanations, immediate step-by-step countermeasures, a 4-7-8 breathing pacer, and store-and-forward Ground Flight Surgeon reports.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS:

AstroHealth Edge OS is a multi-page astronaut medical workstation designed to make crews medically self-sufficient across spacecraft, orbital stations, pressurized surface rovers, and lunar/Mars bases. A zero-dependency Python 3 backend (backed by a local SQLite Electronic Health Record) processes streaming physiological, space weather, and genomic telemetry at 1 Hz alongside manual crew inputs:

- Interactive Digital Twin (#overview): Clickable 5-system body schematic (Brain, Lungs, Heart, Metabolic/Immune, Muscle/Bone) providing plain-language measurement instructions, hazard links, escalation thresholds, and mission routine checklists.

- Guided Self-Exam & Visual Inspection (#exam): Records cuff blood pressure (with Mean Arterial Pressure calculation), blood glucose, core body temperature, and camera/ultrasound lesion captures directly into SQLite.

- Crew Countermeasure Logs (#logs): Tracks daily nutrition/hydration (kcal, protein, water, Vitamin D), resistive/cardio exercise (which dynamically lowers the live OSD-195 muscle atrophy risk multiplier), and mood/sleep journals.

- Live Scientific Telemetry (#telemetry): Displays 7 interactive SVG charts (EMA SpO2/HR, P01 Proton Flux & dPhi/dt slope, 5-axis Readiness Radar, OSD-195 Gene Expression, Glucose/Temp, Stress & 250 mSv BFO dose budget, Arterial BP/MAP) plus blood gas biomarkers (pO2, pCO2, pH, Lactate, Cortisol, CRP, Hemoglobin, WBC).

- Explainable Algorithms (#algorithms): Shows live step-by-step Python mathematical substitutions for EMA (alpha=0.30), 5-sample OLS proton flux slope (SPE warning > 1.5 pfu/s), Severinghaus pO2-to-SpO2 conversion, OSD-195 atrophy risk, Mental Stress Index (4-100), and Spaceflight Modified NEWS2 clinical acuity triage.

- Behavioral Wellness & Store-and-Forward Downlink (#wellness, #deploy): Includes a rectangular 4-7-8 vagal breathing pacer, telemetry-grounded behavioral companion, custom dataset uploader/cleaner (ICARTT, OSD-195, MIMIC-III, simulation_feed.csv), and one-click Flight Surgeon JSON report export.

INTENDED IMPACT & DESIGN CONSIDERATIONS:

Because long-duration deep-space crews face up to 22-minute one-way communication delays, AstroHealth Edge OS requires zero cloud connectivity to monitor vitals, triage emergencies, and archive medical records—remaining deployable in constrained spacecraft Docker environments. Its SpaceX-inspired dark flight-deck interface avoids circular gauge clutter, prioritizing rapid visual color-coding, segmented readiness bars, and plain-language guidance for non-physician crew members.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & HARDWARE/SOFTWARE:

- Edge Backend & Data ETL: Python 3.10 standard library (http.server, sqlite3, csv, threading)

- Gateway & Streaming: Node.js, Express, WebSockets (ws), TypeScript

- Frontend UI: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, custom precision SVG scientific charts

- Deployment: Docker & Docker Compose with persistent SQLite volume storage
